systems.system: SECOP (Système électronique de délivrance des pièces administratives et de la commande publique)

BFA.note: SECOP only delivers administrative certificates to bidders; a full e-procurement platform is only promised for coming months, no tender or bid system is stated.
Trade-register and non-bankruptcy certificates are obtained through SECOP, but no firm registration or register is stated.

facts.fact: The Minister of Economy and Finance launched SECOP on 23 June 2025, a portal through which firms request and receive administrative certificates (tax, CNSS, trade-register, non-bankruptcy and others) remotely.
